facts_and_limits: Healthy68 has token set545..550, but ordered entries regress547→546,548→547,549→548,550→549. All182 entries show the same raw client x0. Same client is not a thread identifier or proof of one serial wait stream; concurrent contexts, omitted observations or repeated checks cannot be disambiguated.

177 e00002d5 and5 zero returns are separate snapshot populations. Healthy pending status is common; a percentage threshold cannot classify freeze. Equal entry/return counts and adjacency do not authorize pairing.

Actual65 display.primary samples captured can_update_ SwapWait and usleep retry locations. Static code retries nonzero returns for about1ms guest monotonic with100us sleeps. The original kernel pending mode with bit31 can return e00002d5; this establishes a plausible wait boundary, not a lost-completion cause.

Entry raw x0 can group observed client values within an attempt, not name a process/thread or compare object identity across boots. Tokens are opaque low32 values; differences are not frame counts. Keep full raw X registers.
One-second logging with global nochain perturbs all execution. No per-block time/CPU identity exists; ordering is logfile serialization only. Snapshot counts are not invocation rates.
